title: Healing Cancer Beyond Medicine: Raising Your Energy, Raising Your Health
content: Healing Cancer Beyond Medicine: Raising Your Energy, Raising Your HealthKarla Mans GirouxSep 25, 20252 min readUpdated: Sep 26, 2025by Justine Laidlaw, Certified Radical Remission Coach, New ZealandEverything in our universe—including our thoughts, emotions, and bodies—carries a vibrational frequency. High vibrations such as love, gratitude, joy, and peace expand our energy field, supporting our immune system and creating a fertile ground for healing.Low vibrations like fear, anger, grief, and resentment contract our energy, placing stress on the body and often blocking the flow of healing. When we become aware of this energetic truth, we can begin to consciously shift our inner state.I often guide clients to think in terms of energy deposits and energy deficits. Energy deposits are the choices and activities that raise our vibration and “fill our cup”—things like sleeping well, spending time with animals, listening to an inspiring podcast, or connecting with thrivers who have defied the odds. Energy deficits, on the other hand, drain us—overwhelm, self-criticism, constant busyness, or being surrounded by negativity.Simple daily practices—gratitude journaling, meditation, uplifting music, or time in nature—help us tip the balance toward deposits rather than deficits.Healing is not about denying difficult emotions, but about meeting them with compassion and then choosing to move toward higher states of being. Each shift, no matter how small, creates ripples of lightness and possibility in the body and spirit.When we align ourselves with higher vibrations and consciously make energy deposits, we strengthen our natural ability to heal and thrive.Justine's Coaching Philosophy:I see coaching as a journey where science meets soul — a chance to reconnect with inner wisdom and trust the body’s natural intelligence. Having healed from stage 3 colon cancer myself, I guide clients to look beyond the physical, uncover the deeper roots of illness, and step into a life of hope, empowerment, and vitality. I especially love welcoming clients into the Radical Remission workshops I run in New Zealand and Australia, where the collective wisdom and connection naturally raise our vibration and inspire deeper healing.Special Offer: “Raise Your Vibration” Clarity Call If this wisdom resonates and you feel called to take a gentle next step, I’m offering a FREE 15-minute 1:1 Clarity Call with me.In this private chat, we’ll: Identify your current energy deposits vs deficits (Optional) Add you to the early interest list for my next Radical Remission Workshop — Feb 2026. This mini call is my gift to you for choosing yourself and your healing path.
